Topic 2.1.7: School rules

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: School rules
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the school learner should be able to: the importance of school rules. rules?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain School rules
2. give Kenyan examples of School rules
3. practise a safe skill for School rules

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ School rules

Teach
• Observe School rules in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about School rules (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to School rules.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for School rules.
• Write 5 bullet facts about School rules.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on School rules.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for School rules: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the school learner should be able to: the importance of school rules. rules?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know School rules with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
